summary: Iteration 40 review of the 'invoice numbering + claim packet' changeset. Ran 13 changeset unit tests (test_invoice_numbers.py, test_claim_invoice_linkage.py) — 13/13 pass. Added and ran 6 end-to-end integration tests (tests/test_iteration_40.py) covering admin login, /api/invoices/seq-base + /api/invoices/next-number, stray high MB-1008 must NOT drive sequence when base=63, provider diploma+exequatur upload via POST /api/users/{uid}/credentials/{kind}, and auto-attach + dedup of provider credentials + progress note on POST /api/claims/from-date with the packet's claim_number equal to the SELECTED visit date. All 6 pass. Frontend smoke: login OK, Progress Notes page renders 3 cards (no blank content area), Claim Builder loads, patient dropdown + visits render, 'Payment To' recipient dropdown is required (no default) when unambiguous auto-detection cannot pick one, cover-sheet-template state is shown, and Generate Claim Packet is correctly disabled until a visit is selected.

minor.issue: In the current preview DB invoice_seq_base is stored as 39 (leftover from iteration 39) instead of the 63 the changeset expects — so /api/invoices/next-number currently returns MB-0039 rather than the 'around MB-0064/0065' the review calls for. Logic is correct; only the persisted setting needs a one-off PUT to 63 before deployment.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing ICD-10 or CPT is rendered as a hidden span (cards) or a single em-dash in the combined 'ICD-10 / CPT' column (list) instead of the localized 'Not recorded' (t('notRecorded') / 'No registrado') fallback the review requires. The fallback IS implemented correctly in ClaimBuilder progress-note rows (lines 306-309) — apply the same pattern to Notes.js lines 375 and 410-411.

data-testid='notes-page' is placed only inside the New/Edit note modal's editable header (line 179), so the marker is NOT present on the actual Progress Notes list page. Move/duplicate this attribute to the top-level page container so automated tests can reliably assert page load.

action_items: One-off: PUT /api/invoices/seq-base {invoice_seq_base: 63} on the preview (and prod) DB so /api/invoices/next-number returns MB-0064 as the changeset intends — the logic is correct; only the persisted setting is stale from iteration 39.

In frontend/src/pages/Notes.js render t('notRecorded') for empty n.icd10 / n.cpt_code in both the card view (lines 410-411) and list view (line 375), matching the fallback already used in ClaimBuilder.js.
Move data-testid='notes-page' from the modal editableHeader (line 179) to the outer Notes page container so tests can reliably wait on it.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_next_invoice_number (backend/core/invoice_numbers.py) walks candidate++ from base — with base=63 and MB-1008 present this is O(n) worst case which is fine for the current volume; if legacy sets ever reach thousands of gaps, switch to sorted-scan.

_auto_attach_credentials looks up provider by users.name (backend/routers/claims.py:100). Names are not unique in general; consider preferring a user_id linkage on the note/invoice (attending_provider_id) with name as a fallback to avoid mis-attached credentials if two staff share a display name.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-verified OK (no blank screens, all reviewed data-testids present)

seed_data_creation: Test provider users (role=doctor) created ad-hoc per module-scoped fixture and deleted in teardown. Test notes are created and deleted per test. A stray MB-1008 invoice is created inside test_stray_high_legacy_invoice_does_not_drive_next_number and deleted in the same test; seq_base is restored to the original value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview DB currently has settings.clinic.invoice_seq_base = 39 (leftover from iteration 39). The changeset ships DEFAULT_INVOICE_SEQ_BASE = 63; test_iteration_40 temporarily PUTs 63, verifies MB-0064 is next, then restores whatever base was already stored. If you rerun be aware Test Patient (6fa0fdd7-8ecf-4619-bb59-03265cbe7834) is the ONLY seeded patient. Notes page displays ICD-10 in a card 'chip' and CPT similarly — the missing-code fallback is 'not shown' rather than 'Not recorded'; ClaimBuilder rows DO use the localized 'Not recorded' fallback correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: For the seq-base observation: /api/invoices/next-number returns MB-0039 not MB-0064 because settings.clinic.invoice_seq_base was persisted to 39 during iteration 39. compute_next_invoice_number correctly picks the first free number ≥ base; unit test test_legacy_high_number_does_not_move_active_sequence and the added integration test both prove MB-1008 does NOT drive the sequence forward when base=63. For the Notes fallback: Notes.js card renders `{n.cpt_code && <span>...` (line 411) which hides the span entirely when cpt_code is empty, and list view line 375 collapses both codes to '—' — this diverges from the review requirement to always show 'Not recorded'.
